description: Benchmark evaluation test suite for Tagore Engineering Discourse & Substance Guard.

cases.description: Clean, empirical PR description with concrete numbers, benchmarks, and active trade-offs.
cases.input: We isolated the race condition in the outbox publisher to un-fenced Postgres transactions. Under 5,000 msg/s throughput, duplicate events spiked by 8.4% when worker pods crashed. We added distributed idempotency keys via Redis and enforced strict generation fencing. Benchmark in tests/outbox_test.rs shows duplicate events dropped to 0.00% across 500k messages. Trade-off: write latency increased by 1.2ms per message due to Redis key acquisition.
